score_aggregation: mean frame score, then maximum member-class score per category
specificity_rule: A qualifying horn or siren removes traffic from primary-label candidates; other qualifying categories remain eligible. Unmapped classes stay in other.

traffic.label: Ice cream truck, ice cream van

animal.label: Bird vocalization, bird call, bird song

other_rule: If the maximum unmapped class score is at least the selected supported category score, report other with uncertainty.
